articles.summary: Oct. 22, 2025- PROG Holdings, Inc. (NYSE:PRG), the fintech holding company for Progressive Leasing, Four Technologies, and Build, today announced the sale of its Vive Financial credit card receivables portfolio to Atlanticus Holdings Corporation (NASDAQ: ATLC).
